landing.hero_accent: Watch what actually makes you sharper
landing.hero_subtitle: YouTube ranks hooks. Lurnia ranks videos people actually learned from (comments, likes, depth), then turns them into a playbook you can run now.
landing.search_placeholder: What do you actually need to get done?
landing.rank_hint: Ranked by real engagement. Not views. Not the thumbnail.
landing.demo_answer: Top result isn't the 8M-view recap. It's a 90k-view lecture with 4x the comment rate and a 12% like rate.
landing.demo_citation: Value score 91 · High discussion · Hidden gem
landing.how_subtitle: Search a topic. We pull relevant videos, then sort them by whether people actually engaged.
landing.step1_desc: A skill, a bottleneck, a decision. Not a binge topic. We start from relevance, then kill the bait.
landing.step2_desc: Comment rate, like rate, and long-form depth beat raw views. Shorts stay hidden unless you ask.
landing.step3_desc: Takeaways, sequenced actions, timestamps, and what to skip. Then ask the video the question YouTube won't answer.
landing.benefits_subtitle: Stop wasting time on high-view, low-value videos
landing.benefit1_desc: A short list of high-discussion videos instead of the same viral thumbnails.
landing.benefit2_desc: Smaller channels with dense comments often teach better than mega-viral recaps.
landing.benefit3_desc: YouTube doesn't publish saves or shares. We use comments and likes vs views, the public signals that people cared.
landing.benefit4_desc: Once you pick a result, ask a question and get an answer from captions or comments.
landing.cta_subtitle: Search a topic for free. No credit card required.
landing.faq1_q: How is Lurnia different from YouTube search?
landing.faq1_a: YouTube is paid to hook you. We re-rank by whether people actually talked, liked, and stayed. Thumbnails don't get a vote.
landing.faq2_a: No. High views with dead comments is usually a stop-scroller. We score comment rate, like rate, and long-form depth.
landing.faq3_a: The usable extract: takeaways, sequenced actions, timestamps, and what to skip, so you don't rewatch a 40-minute recap.
landing.faq4_q: Can I ask the video questions?
landing.faq4_a: Yes. Open any result and ask for the number, the caveat, or the next step. Answers come from captions and comments, not vibes.
landing.faq5_q: What is the Lurnia Chrome extension?
landing.faq5_a: A free Chrome extension that does the same job on youtube.com: re-rank by comments, like rate, and long-form depth, extract a playbook, and ask the video from captions. Click Add to Chrome, then open YouTube. Works in Chrome, Edge, and Brave.
